_comment: [OPUS-4.8] COVERAGE RATCHET (sq-hbg7) — committed per-crate line-coverage FLOOR, reviewed in diffs exactly like the conformance ratchet counts in .github/workflows/ci.yml. CI runs scripts/coverage-gate.py --check-robust (sq-x4jy): it re-measures ONLY the sub-floor crates up to K=3 times and keeps the per-crate MAX (llvm-cov only undercounts), FAILING only if a crate is STILL below its floor after K independent measurements — a genuine regression.
Floor = floor(measured) - 2 (min 0): a small margin so run-to-run / toolchain noise never trips the gate. The floor only ever RISES (--seed will not lower it without --allow-lower).

Tiering: the FAST/MEDIUM crates are measured + gated PER-COMMIT; the heavy sparq-vectors 50k recall/diskann tests are EXCLUDED per-commit (measured in the NIGHTLY tier — see the .github/workflows/ci.yml coverage-nightly job and the per-crate notes below). No crate is silently dropped.
Floors with floor:0 are crates whose llvm-cov line% is a known measurement artifact (see each note) — they are guarded by the test-PRESENCE gate (bench/coverage-presence.json) instead of the % gate.
Regenerate after a deliberate coverage rise: scripts/coverage.sh && scripts/coverage-gate.py --seed target/coverage/coverage-summary.json

sparq-mpc.note: [OPUS-4.8] sq-qcnn.26: mutation-directed DIRECT unit tests on the Shamir share/reconstruct algebra (enumerated via cargo mutants -p sparq-mpc -f shamir.rs -f robust.rs). Added value-asserting tests for the robust Berlekamp-Welch helpers (eval_poly / trim_trailing_zeros / poly_mul_linear / poly_divmod / lagrange_at_zero(_poly) / solve_linear_system / for_each_combination / check_distinct_points / disagreeing_points / berlekamp_welch) and for the degree-reduce fail-closed precondition (deficient n<2t+1 via with_unchecked_threshold), the degree-2t equality-open per-operator security boundary and the malicious_security no-redundancy (n<=t+1) arm, dealer accessors, ShamirDealer/MacSession Debug redaction, and extract_single_integer shape guards — killing surviving comparison-flip / numeric-arithmetic / &&-||-guard-flip / default-body mutants the end-to-end round-trips missed. Measured line% 94.42 (default features, cargo llvm-cov -p sparq-mpc); floor 88->90 per the bead (conservative, >2 margin). Provably-equivalent survivors LEFT (no test can distinguish; documented, not gamed): (1) reconstruct_robust_attributed 'n==degree+1' -> 'n==degree' is unreachable given the earlier n>=degree+1 guard, and the BW e=0 path returns the identical secret/cheaters; (2) any arithmetic mutation of the e_max bound (n-degree-1)/2 that enlarges the correction budget (the -degree, -1 and /2 variants) is masked because berlekamp_welch returns None for every e where n<degree+2e+1, so the enlarged budget is never usable; (3) the berlekamp_welch rem-exactness check == flip is masked by the authoritative downstream disagreeing_points all-points re-verification (and vacuous on the empty-rem exact-division path); (4) the best_effort_suspects '<'->'<=' tie-break only reorders equally-good reference subsets on the best-effort (documented non-sound) abort-path attribution, and in the one guaranteed regime (the first abort band, which IS tested) all minimum-disagreement subsets are all-honest and yield the identical cheater set; (5) the MacSession Drop alpha-zeroize is memory hygiene with no observable in safe Rust. Semi-honest scope only; NO MPC security/soundness claim (sq-qhy4 gates that).
